connectors.name: Asana
connectors.notes: Signs in through Spade Cloud with your ace account, because Asana requires a client secret Spade can't ship. You can instead register your own MCP app in Asana and enter its client ID and secret. Admins can block or allow each app.

connectors.name: Atlassian
connectors.notes: Jira and Confluence. An admin decides whether API tokens may be used.

connectors.name: Box
connectors.notes: Signs in through Spade Cloud with your ace account, because Box requires a client secret Spade can't ship. A Box admin turns the server on; you can instead use a client ID and secret from Box's Admin Console.

connectors.name: Canva
connectors.notes: Signs in through Spade Cloud with your ace account, because Canva requires a client secret Spade can't ship. You can instead use a client ID and secret from Canva's Developer Portal with Canva MCP switched on. Some tools need Canva Pro.

connectors.name: Cloudflare
connectors.notes: Your Cloudflare account through one server. A user or account API token also works.

connectors.name: GitHub
connectors.notes: A personal access token always works. Sign in shows a code to enter on GitHub once Spade's own GitHub app is registered. Organisations may need to approve the app, and those on Copilot Business or Enterprise must allow MCP servers.

connectors.name: HubSpot
connectors.notes: Signs in through Spade Cloud with your ace account, because HubSpot requires a client secret Spade can't ship. You can instead create an MCP connector in HubSpot (Development, then MCP Connectors) for a client ID and secret.

connectors.name: Hugging Face
connectors.notes: Uses a Hugging Face access token.

connectors.name: Intercom
connectors.notes: US workspaces. EU workspaces add the server by URL: https://mcp.eu.intercom.com/mcp

connectors.name: Notion
connectors.notes: Workspace tokens are for Business and Enterprise plans; a workspace owner creates them.

connectors.name: PayPal
connectors.notes: Live accounts. The sandbox server is https://mcp.sandbox.paypal.com/http

connectors.name: Stripe
connectors.notes: For a key, use an agent API key: from December 2026 Stripe refuses plain secret keys here.

connectors.name: Supabase
connectors.notes: A personal access token also works.

connectors.name: Webflow
connectors.notes: One workspace per sign-in; sign in again to switch.
